title: Accuracy of natural-gas viscosity models across composition and pressure regimes
novelty_statement: First PaperLab-style open benchmark in this repo for natural-gas viscosity model-path accuracy with reproducible data artifacts and traceable metrics.

research_questions.question: How does viscosity error vary between SRK and PR model paths across lean, rich, and acid-gas cases?
research_questions.hypothesis: PR path gives lower AARD than SRK on this literature-derived dataset.
research_questions.method: Compute viscosity for each literature point with matched composition, T, and P; evaluate AARD and bias.
research_questions.acceptance_criterion: All metrics stored in results/benchmark_summary.json and discussed in paper.md.

research_questions.question: Are errors regime-dependent rather than globally uniform?
research_questions.hypothesis: Error magnitude increases for richer/acid-gas points.
research_questions.method: Tag cases by regime in data/literature_dataset.csv and compare signed residuals.
research_questions.acceptance_criterion: Regime-level error discussion included in manuscript section 5.
